_doc: D28 audit manifest — the handoff artifact for the fairness lane. Each entry in 'audits' fully specifies one independent audit of D27-registered assumptions. The gate (tools/fairness_assumption_audit_gate.py) REFUSES to invent justification fields: every entry must carry owner/status/justification/justification_evidence or the gate blocks it. Empty 'audits' = the gate reports DORMANT (never 'audited'). The day the first entry lands, enforcement activates with zero new wiring.
_notes: owner must be ENVIRONMENT, WORKER, or HUMAN_AUTHORITY. SCHEDULER is accepted at input so the audit can REJECT it by name (circularity) — never use it expecting a pass.
model_constraint is the assumption's footprint in the lasso model: NONE for documentary assumptions (they skip G3's redundancy check via in_qualification_scope=false but still face G1/G2).
excluded_behaviors names deleted failures as '<BROKEN_KIND>:<verdict>' (e.g. 'BROKEN_SF:SF_ONLY_VIOLATION'). A deleted failure not named here is rigging, not scoping (G4).
status must be JUSTIFIED for the assumption to carry a qualification; anything else fails G1.

claim.qualification_artifact: name of the verdict artifact being audited (may never appear in justification_evidence)

_schema_example.justification: why a human reviewer believes this assumption holds
